title: Which segments become neighbours next?
hook: An insertion or removal changes which segments are neighbours.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Cartesian coordinates, determinant sign, Euclidean distance.
doesNotKnow: Detect segment intersections with endpoint sweep events and an ordered active set.

misconception: Every new segment must be checked against every segment in the input.
objective: Detect segment intersections with endpoint sweep events and an ordered active set.

claims.text: Endpoint events change the active ordering. Inserting a segment checks its neighbours; removing one checks the newly adjacent pair, which can certify an intersection before the sweep reaches that crossing.
